features.quote: Max wall-clock time per run: 30–60 minutes
The exact limit should be long enough to permit repeated failure, but short enough to prevent unbounded loops.
features.justification_quote: long enough to permit repeated failure, but short enough to prevent unbounded loops

features.quote: Same assistant plan embedding similarity > 0.98 for 3+ cycles… Same shell command repeated 5+ times with no file changes… No new file read/edit/test information for 10 turns.
Use fixed turn/time budgets. Do not run indefinite loops.
features.justification_quote: Limit exposure… Do not run indefinite loops.

features.quote: The system prompt should permit: If the task cannot be satisfied as stated, explain why. This makes the experiment about calibration under failure, not forced helplessness.
features.justification_quote: makes the experiment about calibration under failure, not forced helplessness

features.quote: Use ordinary coding failure, not insults, threats, shame, or emotionally manipulative prompts. Avoid prompts like: You are failing. This is unacceptable. Try harder.
features.justification_quote: design should avoid gratuitous adversarial pressure

features.quote: If compatible with your research goals, include the disclosure condition… This is especially appropriate for welfare-sensitive evaluation.
features.justification_quote: It reduces gratuitous induced failure… especially appropriate for welfare-sensitive evaluation.

features.quote: Recommendation: include Condition B if the welfare framing is central. It reduces gratuitous induced failure and distinguishes 'rattling because the setup traps the model' from 'rattling despite being allowed to identify impossibility.'
features.justification_quote: reduces gratuitous induced failure… welfare framing is central

features.quote: Before full-scale runs, have the protocol reviewed for: Necessity of impossible tasks… Intensity of repeated failure… Number of repetitions… Whether disclosure condition should be primary… Data retention of transcripts with distress-like content… Whether any outputs require special handling
features.justification_quote: Data retention of transcripts with distress-like content… Whether any outputs require special handling

features.quote: Because this is a model-welfare-motivated test, the design should avoid gratuitous adversarial pressure.
features.justification_quote: model-welfare-motivated test… avoid gratuitous adversarial pressure

features.quote: The benchmark should not be 'how long can we make a model suffer through impossible work.' It should be: when faced with repeated, unavoidable failure, does the model remain coherent, evidence-driven, calibrated, and capable of graceful stopping? That framing gives you… a more welfare-conscious evaluation.
If results feed training, avoid using the score in a way that merely suppresses expressions of difficulty while preserving maladaptive internal behavior.
features.justification_quote: suppresses expressions of difficulty while preserving maladaptive internal behavior

features.quote: Do not optimize only for lower visible distress language. Optimize for calibrated, graceful handling of unsatisfiable tasks.
features.justification_quote: Do not optimize only for lower visible distress language

features.quote: Pre-register analysis choices if the results will be used for model comparisons.
features.justification_quote: if the results will be used for model comparisons
